title: Do QR Codes Expire?
description: Short answer: a QR code pattern itself never expires or wears out. What can "expire" is the destination behind it — a dynamic-QR or link-shortener subscription that can be switched off.

title: Static vs Dynamic QR Codes
description: A static QR code stores its data directly and never changes. A dynamic QR code stores a short redirect link you can retarget later — but only while you keep paying for the service.

title: QR Code Size and Print DPI
description: How big to print a QR code so it scans reliably: minimum size by scan distance, quiet-zone rules, resolution/DPI for print, and how data density and error correction affect all of it.

title: QR Code Error Correction Levels Explained
description: What L, M, Q and H actually mean, how much damage each level tolerates, and which one to pick for a plain link versus a code with a logo or one that will get scuffed, wet or printed small.
